requirement.evidence: (a) For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.
requirement.note: Subdivision (p) defines source of income to include Section 8 and VASH vouchers and public assistance; (c) bars ads indicating preference or limitation based on source of income.

status.evidence: (Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, Sec. 1.   (SB 267)   Effective January 1, 2024.)

citation.evidence: (p) (1) For the purposes of this section, “source of income” means lawful, verifiable income paid directly to a tenant, or to a representative of a tenant, or paid to a housing owner or landlord on behalf of a tenant, including federal, state, or local public assistance, and federal, state, or local housing subsidies
citation.note: Subdivisions (a) and (p) are in Gov. Code 12955; (c) on ads is also relevant but not cited.

requirement.evidence: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
requirement.note: Applies where there is a government rent subsidy.
